# DSH Isolated Runtime

Current entry: Kubernetes Cell resources for the multi-tenant platform. Use the selected release's fixed package/image identities; source candidates do not change published artifacts.

- [Current package usage](packages/cell-cli/README.md)
- [Distribution and release](docs/distribution.md)
- [Architecture and ownership](docs/specs/architecture.md)
- [Threat model](docs/specs/threat-model.md)
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md)
- [Shared POC roadmap](ROADMAP.md)
- [Contributor instructions](AGENTS.md)

Historical standalone/local-cluster instructions live under docs/archive/ and do not describe the current npm entry. Platform owns OIDC/user admission; runtime owns Cell identity and resources; DSH owns application protocols. Do not place credentials in docs or logs or silently delete user data.
